objective: Make design directions legible at human pace — render the /dev-plan direction gate as a static, scannable HTML page so the maintainer reviews visually, then answers the gate in-session. Pillar 3 (the dashboard) of the rung-C contract-driven-delegation program, delivered first.
recommendation: Recommended the thin end-to-end slice (prove the whole contract -> worker -> fidelity-check -> dashboard loop small). Maintainer chose Dashboard-first: build the render-only direction dashboard first; the contract-fidelity harness + downstream/local workers are later pillars.

options.label: Dashboard-first
options.description: Build the visual steering surface first; it backs onto the existing /dev-plan + specs, with the contract/worker/fidelity machinery riding on top in later phases. Solves the text-too-fast pain soonest.

options.label: Thin end-to-end slice
options.description: One real contract -> a worker runs it -> a deterministic fidelity check -> a minimal dashboard. Proves the whole loop small and dogfoods the dashboard on real data.

options.label: Fidelity-spine-first
options.description: Build the contract schema + deterministic acceptance-check first (CLI/text); dashboard stays text. Strongest if proving fidelity is the real unknown.

assumptions.text: A render-only dashboard relieves the throughput pain — the bottleneck is processing dense text, not the latency of deciding.
assumptions.resolution: Accepted at the gate; interactive click-to-decide deferred to a later pillar.

assumptions.text: A one-shot generated HTML file suffices over an always-on watching server.
assumptions.resolution: Down-scoped to the generator (a strict subset of a future watching server); live-server filed to Blockers with a re-trigger.

assumptions.text: The /dev-plan direction gate is the right first surface to render.
assumptions.resolution: Accepted; general project-state/roadmap is orienting context around the brief.

assumptions.text: A small /dev-plan integration is in-scope — dev-plan emits a structured direction-brief at the gate.
assumptions.resolution: Accepted; down-scopes to render-existing-files-only if non-trivial.

open_decisions: A2: live-server vs one-shot generator — re-trigger if regenerate-by-hand becomes a friction bottleneck
Pillars 1-2 (contract-fidelity harness, downstream/local workers) — later phases
